title: Installment Basis for New Payment Plans on Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Rule.** For a new payment plan on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts, the standard installment is the greatest of the band's minimum monthly plan installment, the band's minimum percent of the balance on the day the offer is made, and that balance divided by the band's maximum number of monthly plan installments. The installment basis is then set as follows:

1. When an arrangement offer of the account whose offer date falls fewer than 12 whole months before today carries a Social Security award letter, a physician's medical disability statement or a state unemployment benefit determination as its hardship document, the standard installment is replaced by the balance divided by the band's maximum number of monthly plan installments.
2. When no such offer exists and the latest payment-plan offer of the account with the status broken has a broken date fewer than 12 whole months before today and ran 6 whole months or more from its acceptance date to its broken date, the standard installment is replaced by the greater of the standard installment and that broken plan's installment amount.
3. Otherwise the standard installment stands.

Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's. No two arrangements of an account break on the same day, since an account has only one arrangement in force at a time. Only payment-plan offers are read for the second line; a broken settlement is not.

## Maximum number of monthly plan installments by band

| Band 1 | Band 2 | Band 3 | Band 4 | Band 5 | Band 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 24 | 36 | 48 | 60 | 60 | 72 |

## Decision table

| Hardship document on an offer in the last 12 whole months | Latest broken plan broke fewer than 12 whole months ago | That plan ran 6 whole months or more | Installment basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | any | Balance divided by the maximum number of installments |
| No | Yes | Yes | Greater of the standard installment and the broken plan's installment |
| No | Yes | No | Standard installment |
| No | No | any | Standard installment |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Band 3 account, balance $6,000.00, an offer of last month carries an unemployment determination: the basis is $6,000.00 divided by 48, $125.00.
- Band 3 account, balance $6,000.00, no hardship document; its latest broken plan, with a $180.00 installment, was accepted on 15 January and broke on 15 July of the same year (6 whole months), four whole months before today: the basis is the greater of $150.00 and $180.00, that is $180.00. Had it broken on 14 July (5 whole months), the basis would be $150.00.
